what: The Swagger Petstore (OpenAPI 3.0) description and real answers recorded from the service, for the openapi tool's tests (phase 36, D15 rules 3 and 4).
scrubbed: the request id the service put in its 500 answer was replaced by <scrubbed>; nothing else was changed. No credential or personal data is in these files (the scan kind runs over them).

files.inventory-500.json: GET /store/inventory, 500 application/json (the service's own error shape on the day)

rerecord: scripts/rerecord-fixtures.sh in this module (by hand, before a release; never in CI)
